source='''from collections import deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    outside = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]\n    q = deque()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in (0, w - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == 0 and not outside[r][c]:\n                outside[r][c] = True\n                q.append((r, c))\n    for c in range(w):\n        for r in (0, h - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == 0 and not outside[r][c]:\n                outside[r][c] = True\n                q.append((r, c))\n    while q:\n        r, c = q.popleft()\n        for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):\n            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == 0 and not outside[nr][nc]:\n                outside[nr][nc] = True\n                q.append((nr, nc))\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    filled = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]\n    color_by_side = {3: 8, 5: 4, 7: 3}\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] != 0 or outside[r][c] or filled[r][c]:\n                continue\n            cells = []\n            q.append((r, c))\n            filled[r][c] = True\n            while q:\n                rr, cc = q.popleft()\n                cells.append((rr, cc))\n                for nr, nc in ((rr - 1, cc), (rr + 1, cc), (rr, cc - 1), (rr, cc + 1)):\n                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == 0 and not outside[nr][nc] and not filled[nr][nc]:\n                        filled[nr][nc] = True\n                        q.append((nr, nc))\n            rs = [rr for rr, _ in cells]\n            cs = [cc for _, cc in cells]\n            side = max(max(rs) - min(rs) + 1, max(cs) - min(cs) + 1)\n            color = color_by_side[side]\n            for rr, cc in cells:\n                out[rr][cc] = color\n    return out\n'''
